summary: PSQ Holdings, Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing an Asset Purchase Agreement dated July 28, 2025 (likely a typo for 2026) with FreeHold Brands, LLC. PSQ, through subsidiaries EveryLife, Inc. and EveryLife Women, LLC, will sell assets comprising its EveryLife diaper and baby products brand for $5.5 million in gross cash proceeds, subject to customary adjustments. Assets include inventory, e-commerce storefronts, customer data, IP, and certain contracts. Closing is expected by September 30, 2026, subject to customary conditions. No board recommendation or advisor named. The transaction is a straightforward asset sale; watch for completion risk and use of proceeds.
